g.text: Products, Dough, Unique Dough, Pans and Critical Lookup Information: the typed lists every other sheet looks up.

rect.data-description: INPUT (typed). Item number. F5xxxx is the case version of Fxxxx. The key for every lookup in the workbook. Feeds: row lists of Sunday to Friday (A3), DSD_DSnD (A8), Dist_DSnD (A287), DoughWeights (A4), Mix-Slice-Oven (A6), Oven_Info (A410).
INPUT (typed). Item name. Feeds: every Description and _Desc column, UniqueDough List of Count. Also searched for the text OBS by the DoughWeights row list (see issue).

INPUT (typed). FG (277 packs), FG-DIST (122 cases), OBS (79 obsolete). Feeds: the row lists (day tables FG + FG-DIST, DSD_DSnD FG, Dist_DSnD FG-DIST, Mix-Slice-Oven and Oven_Info skip OBS), DSD_DSnD Gen. Prod., schedule Bag Count DSD vs DIST split.

INPUT (typed). Production line: Breadline, Breadline/Artisan, MCS LINE, 3rd Party, 3rd Party - Bake, Third Party - Repack, Charges / Fees. Feeds: Asset Rank, DSD_DSnD Asset (3rd-party demand branch, Thursday rule), Mix_Slice_Oven Asset (line totals, schedule filters), Oven_Info Pans. Row lists drop Charges / Fees.
INPUT (typed). Pounds of dough in one pack. Feeds: DoughWeight Weight (lb = packs short x Weight), DSD_DSnD Dough Weights (display).
INPUT (typed). The mixing run the item belongs to. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Unique Dough (bags are summed per run), Oven_Info, UniqueDough Count and List of Count, Mix-Slice-Oven A6 sort.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Units per case/Tray, then #of Trays/Cases Needed on the slice sheet.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Oven_Info # of pieces per tray/box, then # of Pans/Boxes to set out.
INPUT (typed). Dough D-code. Feeds: Dough Description, DoughWeights A4 grouping (each dough followed by its products), Mix_Slice_Oven Dough (the Dough[Weight] divisor), Mix-Slice-Oven A6.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Dough],Dough[No.],Dough[Description]),""). Feeds: DoughWeight Dough Desc, the key dough rows are summed on.
INPUT (typed). Multiplier for waste, for example 1.1. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Scrap Factor (bags x scrap).

FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =IFERROR(MATCH([@Asset],{"Breadline";"Breadline/Artisan";"MCS LINE";"3rd Party";"3rd Party - Bake";"Third Party - Repack"},0),99). 1 Breadline, 2 Breadline/Artisan, 3 MCS LINE, 4 to 6 third party, 99 anything else. Feeds: Mix-Slice-Oven A6 keeps rank 1 to 3 and sorts by it.
INPUT (typed). Pan or box the item is baked or packed in. Feeds: Oven_Info A410 row list and # of Pans/Boxes to set out.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =IF(LEFT([@No.],2)="F5","F"&MID([@No.],3,100),[@No.]). F53070 becomes F3070. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Notes (flags Case Total).
NOT USED. Production BOM No. (C), Unit Cost (D), Unit Price (E), Batch Size (O), Topping (S). No formula reads them.
INPUT (typed). Dough D-code. Feeds: DoughWeights A4 (one block per dough), the Dough Weight SUMIFS key, Products Dough Description.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Products Dough Description, DoughWeight and Mix_Slice_Oven Description on dough rows, UniqueDough Dough Desc.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Pounds in one bag (batch) of dough. Formula: =SUMIFS(BOMQty[BOMQty],BOMQty[No_Item],[@No.]). Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Weight, Dough Weight (L) and every _Bags column: bags = lb / this. See issue: multi-level BOMs are double counted.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =COUNTIFS(UniqueDough[Dough Sku],[@No.]). Number of mixing runs that use this dough. Display only.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,FILTER(UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Dough Sku]=[@No.],"")). Display only.
NOT USED. Type, Item Tracking Code, Production BOM No., Unit Cost, Unit Price, Gen. Prod. Posting Group.
INPUT (typed). Mixing run name; must match Products Unique Dough exactly. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven bags-per-mix and run-time lookups, Oven_Info, the schedule A5 lookups.
INPUT (typed). Order of the run on the day. Feeds: schedule A5 SORTBY; MCS Changeover rows sit at the placement above + 0.5. Text or blank sorts last (9999).
INPUT (typed). Bags per mix. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven optimal bags per mix (CEILING step), Oven_Info Daily Bags Per Mix, schedule mixes per run = ROUNDUP(bags / this).
INPUT (typed). Minutes per mix. Feeds: Mix_Slice_Oven Run Time Per Mix, every _Minutes column, the schedule time column. 7 runs are blank.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =COUNTIFS(Products[Unique Dough],[@Dough]). Display only.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,FILTER(Products[Description],IFERROR(Products[Unique Dough],"")=[@Dough],"")). Display only.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Finds the dough header row above this run on Mix-Slice-Oven. Formula: =LET(r,IFERROR(MATCH([@Dough],'Mix-Slice-Oven'!$C:$C,0),0),rng,'Mix-Slice-Oven'!$H$1:INDEX('Mix-Slice-Oven'!$H:$H,MAX(r,1)),IF(r=0,"",IFERROR(XLOOKUP(TRUE,LEFT(rng,1)="D",rng,"",0,-1),""))). Feeds: Dough Uni Dou # and Uni Dou Desc.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Dough Sku],Dough[No.],Dough[Description]),""). Display only.

rect.data-title: Not read by any formula: 11 columns
rect.data-description: NOT USED. Pan Constraints, 4 Bag Mix, 3 Bag Mix, 2 Bag Mix, 1 Bag Mix, 1.5 Bag Mix, Dough Color, Steamed?, Schedule Notes, Schedule Notes2, Notes. The schedules show these from Critical Lookup Information instead.
INPUT (typed). Pan or box name. Feeds: Oven_Info A410 (one block per pan), Oven_Info Pans = Pan test, Trays and Pieces lookups, Mix-Slice-Oven Y1 count and CA500 listing.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Oven_Info Pieces Per Pan, the divisor for # of Pans/Boxes to set out.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Oven_Info Trays per 1 Bag Mix (display).
NOT USED. No formula reads it.
INPUT (typed). Pallet type per customer. Feeds: Dist Shipping Schedule C2 (for example Chep).

INPUT (typed). A second copy of the Unique Dough list. D run name, E notes (for example 12 bags max in a single run), then attributes and 4/3/2/1/1.5 bag-mix run times. Feeds: schedule N:S columns and D4. Editing Unique Dough does not change what the schedules print.
INPUT (typed). Feeds: Dist_DSnD Column3, cases that can be made from spare DSD packs.
FORMULA (this sheet). V10 =INDEX($V$2:$V$8,MATCH(WEEKDAY(TODAY()),$U$2:$U$8,0)) gives today's tab name (Friday-Inventory).

rect.data-title: Dough Weight double counts BOM levels
rect.data-description: ISSUE. SUMIFS adds every BOMQty line for the dough, including an intermediate (Liquid Levain 60 lb) and its own flour 30 + water 30. D10057 sums 273.25 lb against a real 213.25, so about 22% too few bags. 11 doughs affected: D10020, D10024, D10025, D10051, D10055 to D10059, D10063, D10064.
ISSUE. D10004 = 241.8 and D10061 = 236.1 are typed over the SUMIFS, so BOM changes never reach them.
ISSUE. DoughWeights A4 drops any item whose Description contains OBS. Lobster Roll 12pk (F3310) and Cs. LobsterRoll (F53310), both active MCS LINE, never get dough or bags.
ISSUE. Schedule attributes, notes and D4 run times come from Critical Lookup Information D:O, a separate copy. Update both or retire one.
ISSUE. Constant #N/A values: Asset 75, Weight 92, Unique Dough 101, Scrap Factor 116, Packs Per Tray/Case 92, Batch Size 238 rows.
ISSUE. Products uses run names missing from Unique Dough: Gourmet Hawaiian Bun, 8" Philly Roll, 6" Philly Roll, Bread Stick, 0. Their lookups return blank.
ISSUE. 2# Sour Dough Batard, 3 LB. Braided, 1.5# Artisan Ciabatta, 1.5# Ciabatta Garlic & Rose, Multigrain Batard, 2# PAL Batard, 1.75# PAL Batard: 0 minutes on the schedule.
ISSUE. 'Cntry Wheat Lg Pullman ', 'Country Wheat Hearth ', ' Multigrain Lg Pullman', '22"19oz Steak Crouton '. Exact-match lookups against Products can miss.

Placement_On_Scedule "schedule order" num Optimal_Bag "bags per mix" num Optimal_Time "minutes per mix" text Dough_Sku "formula" } Pans { text Pans_Boxes PK num Pieces_Per_Pan num Trays_Per_1_bag_Mix } BOMQty { text No_Item FK "dough D-code" num BOMQty "component lb" } CriticalLookup { text Run_name PK "column D" text Notes_and_attributes "E to O" num Packs_per_case "Q to S" } DSD_DSnD { text Sku
